description: Production-oriented cardiovascular differential-expression build from approved public GEO and future Expression Atlas/ArrayExpress sources.
notes: Only approved curation-manifest rows should be analyzed into expression v3.
Do not mix GTEx baseline expression into disease-vs-control differential-expression counts.
Store not_significant rows when a gene was tested but did not pass the configured threshold.
Keep legacy expression payloads unchanged until v3 outputs pass parity, provenance, and domain review.
